mapper.select: WITH date_info AS ( -- 학생의 상태에 따라 계산 기준일(reference_date)을 동적으로 설정 SELECT a.account_seq, a.status, a.dropout_date, c.cur_seq, c.cur_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, CASE -- 1. 중도탈락(DROPOUT) 또는 수강철회(EARLYOUT)이고 dropout_date가 있는 경우: 해당 날짜를 기준일로 사용 WHEN a.status IN ('DROPOUT', 'EARLYOUT') AND a.dropout_date IS NOT NULL THEN LEAST(a.dropout_date, c.end_date) -- 2. 정상 재학 중인 경우: 오늘 날짜와 과정 종료일 중 빠른 날짜를 사용 ELSE LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, c.end_date) END as reference_date FROM lms.tb_account a JOIN lms.tb_curriculum c ON a.cur_seq = c.cur_seq WHERE a.account_seq = #{accountSeq} ), calendar AS ( -- 시작일부터 동적으로 정해진 reference_date까지의 실제 수업 날짜 생성 (토/일 제외) SELECT di.account_seq, COUNT(d.day)::int as total_working_days FROM date_info di CROSS JOIN generate_series(di.start_date, di.reference_date, '1 day'::interval) as d(day) WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.day) NOT IN (0, 6) -- 0:일요일, 6:토요일 제외 GROUP BY di.account_seq ) SELECT di.account_seq, a.account_name, a.status as accountStatus, di.cur_name, TO_CHAR(di.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as startDate, TO_CHAR(di.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as endDate, TO_CHAR(di.reference_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as referenceDate, cal.total_working_days, -- 기준일(reference_date) 이전의 데이터만 집계 COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 END)::int as absentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'LATE' THEN 1 END)::int as lateCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'OUTING' THEN 1 END)::int as outingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'EARLY' THEN 1 END)::int as earlyCount FROM date_info di JOIN lms.tb_account a ON di.account_seq = a.account_seq JOIN calendar cal ON di.account_seq = cal.account_seq LEFT JOIN lms.tb_attendance att ON di.account_seq = att.account_seq AND att.attendance_date BETWEEN di.start_date AND di.reference_date GROUP BY di.account_seq, a.account_name, a.status, di.cur_name, di.start_date, di.end_date, di.reference_date, cal.total_working_days

SELECT TO_CHAR(attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "attendanceDate", status as "status", remark as "remark", TO_CHAR(start_time, 'HH24:MI') as "startTime", TO_CHAR(end_time, 'HH24:MI') as "endTime" FROM lms.tb_attendance WHERE account_seq = #{accountSeq} AND (remark IS NOT NULL AND remark != '' OR status != 'PRESENT') ORDER BY attendance_date DESC
